narrative:
## Handover Summary — Actuals & Targets

Targets of EUR 15.6B net sales are locked and cascaded to 40 category × product line × region cells.

## Key Decisions
• Cooking target raised on Gaggenau/Neff built-in momentum
• Rest of World Laundry increased for Profilo/Bosch share gains in Turkey and India
• China held below FY2025 pending trade-in subsidy outlook

## Recommendation for Demand & Volume Plan
Translate the value targets into unit volumes; validate Q4 floorcare peaks and China fridge-freezer downside with the Cortex demand forecast.

signals.title: BP Process Overview — Manual Entry Hotspots
signals.excerpt: Every step of the business planning process involves manual data entry or adjustments in SAC and Excel. Actuals are re-keyed from BW E0P; volume and price assumptions are emailed between controllers.

signals.title: F&C Workshop Munich — UDP Evaluation
signals.excerpt: ~30 F&C stakeholders reviewed ACDOCA access, real-time P&L, Material Ledger and Cortex Analyst. Priority: replace BW E0P, keep SAC as planning frontend, single source for actuals.
